run.model_backend: scripted Messages API stub on disposable loopback
documented_limits: idle-path injection only: the pointer lands while the session sits idle; busy-turn queued_command placement is neither exercised nor claimed
build checking is parked: no build was hashed or qualified; the observed version is recorded only
no Claude hooks are installed in the disposable config, so the legacy UserPromptSubmit display of the backlog is not exercised; the backlog stays readable and unacked in the inbox
deliver_window_ms is the host-side attempting-to-disposition interval, an upper bound on the helper's claude-bindings lock hold; no concurrent hook was timed
